'''Donher Ty''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was employed by [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Centa Sonhan]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was the chief mechanic aboard [[Centa Sonhan's sail barge]]. He was on board when the [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]] was [[Attack on Centa Sonhan's sail barge|attacked]] by agents of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].
